You don’t need to be an expert across every platform from day one, but you’ll bring strong systems thinking, curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new technologies. Support BAU, incidents, changes and projects across the Infrastructure technology stack. Drive automation and systems integration using APIs, scripting and low-code/no-code technologies. Support and improve our ITSM platform, including workflows, integrations, service requests and automation. Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Autopilot, Okta, Azure and associated SaaS platforms. Support identity lifecycle, device management and application deployment. Partner with stakeholders to deliver secure, supportable solutions, improve processes, and document and share knowledge across the team. review_candidates.title: Specialist Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Full-time, Ongoing position Based at Western’s Hawkesbury (Richmond) campus Salary: HEW Level 7 $108,659 – $117,202 plus 17% Super and Leave Loading Bring your network engineering expertise to a complex enterprise environment where reliable, secure connectivity underpins how our students and staff learn, teach, research and work. The Opportunity We are seeking a Specialist Network Engineer to join the Security & Digital Operations team within Digital Services, helping maintain and strengthen the network infrastructure that supports the University’s campuses and digital services. In this role, you will work across a complex enterprise network environment, taking on challenging technical issues and contributing to the design, implementation and ongoing optimisation of secure and reliable network services. You will diagnose and resolve complex network incidents, monitor performance and capacity, and use technical insights to identify emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. You will also contribute specialist advice to network design and planning, helping ensure our infrastructure remains secure, resilient and capable of supporting changing technology and business needs. Working closely with Cybersecurity, IT Operations, Digital Infrastructure, academic and professional teams, vendors and service providers, you will contribute to integrated network solutions that align with the University’s security, governance and regulatory requirements. You will also play an important role in strengthening network resilience through business continuity and disaster recovery planning, maintaining high-quality technical documentation and evaluating new and emerging network technologies. What Success Looks Like: Success in this role will be demonstrated through secure, reliable and scalable network services that meet the University’s current and future operational needs. You will make an impact by: Maintaining secure, reliable and high-performing enterprise network services across a complex, multi-site environment. Diagnosing and resolving complex network incidents, identifying root causes and minimising disruption to critical services. Monitoring network performance, capacity and usage to identify risks and opportunities for improvement before they affect service delivery. Applying your technical expertise to the design, implementation and ongoing improvement of secure network solutions. Working effectively across technical teams and with vendors to resolve issues and deliver integrated solutions. Strengthening network resilience through effective business continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. Maintaining clear and accurate technical documentation that supports effective network operations and knowledge sharing. Keeping abreast of emerging network technologies and identifying where they could improve security, performance, resilience or efficiency. Please refer to the Position Description for full details. About You You are an experienced network professional who enjoys getting to the bottom of complex technical problems and building solutions that are secure, reliable and fit for purpose. You can move comfortably between hands-on troubleshooting and broader network planning and design. You bring sound technical judgement, communicate clearly and can work effectively with specialists, vendors and stakeholders across a large organisation. You will bring: Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Network Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Demonstrated experience implementing, maintaining and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure in a large or complex environment. Strong knowledge of network architecture and protocols, including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs and wireless networking. A strong understanding of cybersecurity principles and their practical application to network infrastructure and design. Hands-on experience with enterprise networking technologies such as Cisco, Juniper or Palo Alto, and network monitoring and diagnostic tools such as SolarWinds, Nagios or Wireshark. Demonstrated ability to investigate complex network issues, identify root causes and implement effective solutions. Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience contributing to network resilience, capacity planning, disaster recovery or the implementation of emerging network technologies within a large-scale environment would also be highly regarded.
